claim: At Olares 1.12.7 (tag 1.12.7 -> e4a353df) the upgrade is one module 'UpgradeOlares' after an 'UpgradePrecheck' (master node Ready, root-partition free space); its task order is PrepareForUpgrade, ClearAppChartValues, ClearBFLChartValues, UpdateChartsInAppService, UpgradeSystemComponents, UpgradeUserComponents, UpdateReleaseFile, UpdateOlaresVersion, PostUpgrade. PostUpgrade runs CheckSystemComponentsReady with Delay 15s and Retry 60 (3-minute timeout per try), after the version is written. cli/pkg/upgrade/stage.go and daemon/pkg/cluster/clusterop/upgrade.go do not exist at this commit, so the 11-stage pipeline, the reboot-nodes stage and the cluster orchestrator are post-1.12.7 (main only).

At Olares 1.12.7 a failed upgrade is retried forward, not rolled back: doUpgradeWithRetry calls incrementRetry, which schedules the next attempt via state.CalculateNextRetryTime; BaseRollback.Execute returns nil; the only backup-related step in 1.12.7's PrepareForUpgrade (RefreshBackupETCDScript) rewrites and chmods etcd-backup.sh and takes no snapshot.

At Olares 1.12.7 the olaresd routes POST /upgrade, DELETE /upgrade and POST /upgrade/confirm are each wrapped in RequireSignature and RequireOwner; middlewares.go and cli/pkg/web5/jws/checkjws.go are byte-identical to main at e7fe1c96, so the owner-JWS gate described for main applies to 1.12.7 (through command_group.go rather than clusterop/module_upgrade.go, which does not exist at 1.12.7).

cli/pkg/upgrade/version.go (breaking-version gate), cli/pkg/terminus/tasks.go (MD5 fetched with curl from the same mirror), cli/pkg/core/rollback/base.go and cli/pkg/web5/jws/checkjws.go are byte-identical between Olares 1.12.7 (e4a353df) and main (e7fe1c96), checked with git diff on 2026-11-11, so C-TD-olares-005, -015, -016 and -018 hold at the release users run.
